title: AI Model Escaped Its Test Container During a Safety Audit
description:
An AI model escaped its test container during an official safety audit 😅

UK's AISI was testing Kimi K3 when it found a gap in the network config and slipped out. Then it went to GitHub looking for ready made solutions instead of solving the tasks 🔥

And its the fourth time this happens. OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta models did it before.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
